title: Cobras Fall 4–2 to Fire Truck Club in Hard-Fought Playoff Battle 2/1/25
description:
Globo Gym King Cobras D vs. Fire Truck Club — Playoff Game #5295
Final Score: Fire Truck Club 4 – Cobras 2
Date: 02/01/26 • League: BH Adult D Playoffs
Location: Baptist Health Iceplex Rink 1
